verdict.rationale: Kong's first-party docs describe an AI Gateway that proxies LLM traffic through a provider-agnostic API spanning OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, Azure and others, with semantic routing. The same docs cover enforcing rate limits, cost tracking, guardrails, and safety/DLP policies on that traffic, plus a dedicated MCP Traffic Gateway for governing, securing and observing MCP traffic. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of token-based (rather than request-based) limits, specific prompt-guard plugin configuration detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
